q: Find the $x$-intercept(s) and $y$-intercept of the graph of $y=\dfrac{-x^2+2x+3}{x^2-5x+6}$. (Give the intercepts as points.)
Find all asymptotes of the graph of $y=\dfrac{x^3-3x^2}{x^2-x-6}$. If there is no asymptote of a particular type, write "none".
Find the point at which the graph of $y=\dfrac{3x^3-2x^2+x+4}{x^2-x+2}$ crosses its slant asymptote.
Find the $x$-intercept(s) and $y$-intercept for the graph of $y=\dfrac{x^2-7x+12}{3x^2-48}$. (Give the intercepts as points.)
Find the point of intersection of the asymptotes of the graph of $f(x)=\dfrac{x^2-15x+55}{27-3x}$.
Find the domain and range of $f(x)=\dfrac{x^2+8}{x^2-4}$.
Given: $f(x)=\dfrac{x^2+2x+1}{(x+2)(x-1)}$. Find the $x$- and $y$-intercepts of the graph of $f$. (Give the intercepts as points.)

A certain rational function can be written as $f(x)=\dfrac{ax^2+bx+c}{x^2+d}$. Find the values of $a$, $b$, $c$, and $d$ so that the graph of $f$ is symmetric about the $y$-axis, has a horizontal asymptote $y=5$, a vertical asymptote $x=3$ and $f(2)=1$.
Given: $f(x)=\dfrac{2x^2-50}{x^3+2x^2-25x-50}$. Find the domain and the range of $f$.
Find the $x$-intercept(s) of the graph of $f(x)=\dfrac{x^2+3x}{x^2+x-6}$.
Let $f(x)=\dfrac{x^2-2x-3}{-4x^2+24x-20}$. Find the coordinates of the point where $f(x)$ intersects its horizontal asymptote.

A certain rational function $R(x)$ can be written as $\dfrac{p(x)}{q(x)}$ where $p(x)$ is a polynomial of degree $2$. $R(x)$ has $x$-intercepts $-\dfrac23$ and $5$, domain $\left\{x : x\ne\dfrac12\right\}$ and asymptote $y=\dfrac38x-\dfrac{23}{16}$. Find $R(x)$.
Find the $x$- and $y$-intercepts of $y=\dfrac{(x^2-25)(2x^2-18)}{x^2+8x+15}$. (Give the intercepts as points.)
Find the point(s) of intersection of the asymptotes of $y=\dfrac{x^3-x^2}{x^2+2x-8}$.
Find the domain and range of $y=\dfrac{2x^3-72x}{2x^3-162x}$.
Find the $x$-intercept(s) of $y=\dfrac{x^2+5x+6}{x^4-x^2-12}$.
Find the intersection point of the graph of $f(x)=\dfrac{3x^3+2x^2-x+10}{x^2+1}$ and its asymptote.

Given the function $f(x)=\dfrac{ax^2+bx+c}{dx^2+e}$ where $a$ and $d$ are relatively prime. The graph of $f$ has a horizontal asymptote of $y=\dfrac32$, a single vertical asymptote of $x=1$, and a $y$-intercept of $6$. Find the product of $b$ and $c$.
Find the $y$-intercept of the graph of $y=\dfrac{(x^2-36)(2x^2-8)}{x^2+8x+12}$.
Find the point of intersection of the asymptotes of the graph of $y=\dfrac{x^3+8x^2+5x-50}{x^2-4x+4}$.
Find the domain and the range of $\left\{(x,y) : y=\dfrac{x^2}{4-x^2}\right\}$.
Find the $x$- and $y$-intercept(s) of $-5xy+x^2-3x+4y-5=0$. (Give the intercepts as points.)
Find the zeros of $f(x)=\dfrac{x^3-2x^2-5x+6}{x^3+3x^2+2x}$.
Find the area of the triangle in the first quadrant bounded by the $x$-axis and the slant and vertical asymptotes of $f(x)=\dfrac{x^3-12x^2-x+15}{3-3x^2}$.
Find the zeros of $y=\dfrac{(x+3)(x^2-4)}{(x+2)(x^2-5)}$.
Find all asymptotes of $y=\dfrac{x^2+5}{x-2}$. If there is no asymptote of a particular type, write "none".
At what point does the graph of $y=\dfrac{(x-1)(2x^3+3x-5)}{x^3-x^2+2x-2}$ cross its asymptote?

In a certain national park, the deer population is estimated by $N=\dfrac{10(5+3t)}{1+0.04t}$, where $N$ is the number of deer and $t$ is the time in years, $t\ge0$. What is the limiting size of the herd as time increases?
Find all points of intersection of the asymptotes of $y=\dfrac{3x^3-10x^2-27x+10}{x^2-3x-10}$.
note: Official answer: no points of intersection.

q: A certain rational function $R(x)$ can be written as $\dfrac{p(x)}{q(x)}$, where $p(x)$ is a polynomial of degree $2$. $R(x)$ has vertical asymptote $x=-3$ and slant asymptote $y=-2x+5$. If $1$ is a zero of $R(x)$, find $R(x)$.
